def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6}
  (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁)
  (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁)
  (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (x : α₁ ⊕ α₂) (y : β₁ ⊕ β₂) : Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) :=
  match x, y with
  | Sum.inl a, Sum.inl b => Finset.map Sum.inl (f₁ a b)
  | Sum.inl a, Sum.inr b => Finset.disjSum (g₁ a b) (g₂ a b)
  | Sum.inr a, Sum.inl b => Finset.empty
  | Sum.inr a, Sum.inr b => Finset.map Sum.inr (f₂ a b)
